correctness.rationale: The channel operation is exactly one deletion and at most one substitution, as defined in the inspected primary articles. Every pairwise received-ball overlap is enumerated directly. Admissible codes are graph cliques. A complete greedy-coloring upper-bound search computes exact clique numbers 5,5,6,8,12; correct branch pruning follows from independent proper color classes and monotone processed-prefix bounds. Witness codebooks attain all five values. Independently implemented Python and C++ verifiers agree; a second Python ball construction checks order-of-operations equality. These finite calculations prove only the stated finite range, not any unrestricted asymptotic theorem.

value.rationale: This supplies a complete finite optimum profile for the most demanding fixed read budget N=5 developed in the 2026 literature. Lengths 5 through 8 are the first four lengths at which every input has enough distinct outcomes to support five distinct observations. The exact cardinalities quantify the tradeoff between short-block storage and five-read recovery and provide sharp reproducible finite baselines not implied by asymptotic redundancies. Length four is included to expose the boundary-vacuity effect. The result is a bounded but natural classification, not arbitrary unmotivated parameter slicing.
